stories.title: ‘We’re not going to go away’: the mom fighting for social media reform after her son’s suicide
stories.summary: A new documentary follows Kristin Bride’s campaign for social-media reform after her 16-year-old son died by suicide following cyberbullying. The film traces her effort to press Congress for change and her determination not to abandon the campaign.

stories.title: Lourdes gets a Vegas glow-up at Dublin theatre festival, where canvases are slashed
stories.summary: ‘Lourdes! The Musical,’ about a drama group’s pilgrimage, brings an effervescent, Vegas-style treatment to the Dublin theatre festival. The broader festival programme also features reflections on activist art, including slashed canvases, and a show about lost languages amid themes of racism, conflict and prejudice.
